prompts.5:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D pixel-art tower-defense sprite parts sheet for the Stone Slinger evolution.
References: image 1 shows the ORIGINAL three tower bases (do not copy the full strip); image 2 shows ORIGINAL fork slingshot animation (use first loaded frame for identity, not a cannon/crossbow).
Generate ONE upgrade stage, three separated components in a SINGLE HORIZONTAL ROW on genuine transparent background: LEFT a compact stationary tower base with empty circular wooden mounting platform, CENTER the detached rotating fork-shaped slingshot weapon ready to fire UP toward top edge, RIGHT its single matching round stone projectile. Large transparent gaps, no overlap, no labels, no frames, no ground/shadow, no text.
Keep exact straight-on elevated top-down game perspective: see oval top platform and front facade, symmetrical centered front (no diagonal/isometric camera). Original red-brown plank facade, broad grey stone footing, metal-rimmed oval platform. Low parapets; no tall walls. Weapon dark metal U/Y fork, two elastic straps converge on a loaded round stone near the lower center. It must still visibly be a SLINGSHOT, not a bow, gun or cannon. Reusable base and rotating weapon are separate sprites.
Crisp low-resolution pixel clusters, dark outline, warm reddish timber, cool iron highlights, restrained gold/red accents, no soft blur, no gradients, no bloom. Readable at base64x84px and weapon56x50px. Compact broad construction; upgrades improve structure/material, NOT height or footprint.
Stage LEVEL 5 reinforced: retain mostly warm timber, stronger silver iron bands across planks, low oval platform iron edge, central red gemstone. Detached weapon: iron fork with wooden joint blocks, taut tan double straps, large warm ochre stone. Detached projectile: simple faceted ochre/brown stone with one bright plane, no magical effects. This is only a moderate step beyond original stage3. Composition generous clear gaps: base occupies left third, weapon middle third, projectile right third.
